exposure: Method of labor induction (oral misoprostol, PGE2 pessary, Foley catheter)
cohort: 520 women who chose their preferred method of labor induction at a French tertiary hospital between July 2019 and October 2020
finding: There was no significant difference in global satisfaction with labor induction between the three methods when chosen by the patients themselves.
mod_finding: This study focused on women's satisfaction with different labor induction methods and found no difference in satisfaction levels based on the chosen method, though it noted that caesarean section was associated with lower satisfaction.
